source_title: China's Super Schools Kill The Curiosity They Sell
summary: This June 19, 2014 On the Level interview gives an earlier Education source than the current July 2014 chronology: PISA panic becomes a civilizational fear story, Gaokao pressure becomes a death of childhood, study abroad becomes an exported mismatch, and empathy is named as a teachable capacity needed for innovation, social trust, and a peaceful Chinese rise.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Gaokao pressure is defended as objective allocation of scarce opportunity even as it turns childhood into early testing, nagging, and total future anxiety.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing lens point is grounded in the July 2014 Sinica source; this earlier June interview supplies the same low-trust exam-protection mechanism through sorting, fairness claims, poor-family ladder anxiety, and resistance to reform.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The Chinese classroom kills curiosity, creativity, imagination, and empathy by treating questions and standing out as troublemaking.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The current public anchor is dated to the 2026 creativity interview; this 2014 interview gives an earlier anti-authority-school formulation that already joins question-asking, creativity, open-ended work, and empathy.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Empathy is teachable in Finland but historically absent from Chinese schooling, leaving strangers outside emotional attachment and making China hard for outsiders to understand.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Human Heart anchor already treats empathy as a born relation that can be broken by school and screens; this source adds the education-policy side where empathy is also an explicit taught capacity.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Revise the Education chronology so the source trail begins with this 2014-06-19 On the Level interview before the 2014-07-14 Sinica interview: June frames PISA as geopolitical fear, Gaokao as death of childhood, and study abroad as a failed escape from the soul habits produced by the school game.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns the chronology because the active mechanism is school formation and the exam/study-abroad game. Power As Alchemy would own education spending as debt absorption only when the source centers monetary conversion rather than student formation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add a compact outbound-study contradiction: the family tries to flee a curiosity-killing system by sending the child into a foreign classroom, but the soul habits produced at home -- silence, non-questioning, fear of standing out, and algorithmic test skill -- make the escape itself painful.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns the mismatch because the mechanism is exported student formation. Bureaucracy or Power As Alchemy would own the university revenue machine only if the active point is institutional self-preservation or debt/tuition conversion.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as an earlier education-specific empathy layer: Jiang defines empathy as putting oneself in another person's shoes, contrasts Finland's explicit teaching with China's stranger problem, and ties empathy to innovation, social glue, cross-cultural management, and a peaceful rise.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns the empathy capacity when the question is relation, social glue, and moral perception; Education owns the classroom and early-childhood machinery that trains or fails to train it.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Reference only as secondary support for Jiang's player-empathy method if a later pass needs an early education source where understanding the other side's thinking becomes a condition for cross-cultural management and geopolitical peace.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory owns empathy as analyst method when it helps name another actor's payoff and worldview. This source primarily belongs to Education and Human Heart because Jiang is discussing school formation and social capacity.

new_lens_seeds.title: Empathy As Civilizational Capacity
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Empathy becomes more than kindness when a school system teaches people to inhabit strangers, other cultures, and future workplaces; without that capacity, innovation, social glue, and peaceful geopolitical rise are all weakened.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can connect later sources on born empathy, school-socialized numbness, psychohistory's need to understand other actors, and China's global misunderstanding, but this source alone should not become a public page before cross-source comparison.

new_lens_seeds.title: Outbound Study As Exported Contradiction
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A family can try to escape a damaging school game by sending the child abroad, but the student carries the old game's habits into a new classroom whose rewards invert them, turning escape into alienation.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism may recur wherever Jiang treats international education as more than mobility or prestige: a transfer of formed souls into an incompatible game. For now it is best held as an Education subsection candidate.

chronology_notes.note: This 2014-06-19 interview predates the current 2014-07-14 Education chronology entry and should become the earliest visible public Education source if the concept page is revised.

By June 2014 Jiang is already joining creativity, imagination, empathy, early-childhood investment, and open-ended work before the 2015 worker-versus-human-being panel and the 2026 creativity interview.
The source gives an early version of empathy as a geopolitical education variable: China's inability to understand how outsiders think is presented as a risk to smooth and peaceful rise.
